title: How to Make $1M+ With a Drone ($1.5K in 30 Minutes)
channel: Chris Koerner on The Koerner Office Podcast
description:
Check out my newsletter at ⁠⁠⁠⁠⁠⁠TKOPOD.com⁠⁠⁠⁠⁠⁠ and join my new community at ⁠⁠⁠⁠⁠⁠TKOwners.com⁠⁠⁠⁠⁠⁠.
____

HoldCo Bros are back! In this episode, @NikonomicsPodcast  and I dive into the drone roof business, one of the easiest ways to start making real money without spending much time getting set up. We talk about why this market keeps growing fast, how simple it is to get your Part 107 license, and what people are actually charging per job. We go over how the work itself looks from start to finish, and why it’s smarter to sell it as roof condition documentation instead of inspections. I share a case study of an operator making seven figures, who’s pulled in $15K–$30K in a single day after storms, and explain how he keeps steady work from roofers, insurance companies, and property managers. We wrap up with how to get your first clients using Google Business Profile, city-based search terms, and small add-ons like thermal scans, mapping, or short video clips. If you’ve been wanting a simple, low-cost business that’s in demand and doesn’t involve climbing roofs, this one’s for you.
